sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.version_commit: W3C Recommendation published 2024-12-12; the page identifies the dated stable version https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/; current-version URL is a mutable alias.
sources.locator: SC 1.2.2 Level A; SC 1.2.3 Level A; SC 1.2.5 Level AA; SC 1.2.8 Level AAA.
observed_operations: Located and read the normative criteria for prerecorded captions, audio description/media alternative, audio description, and media alternative.
sources.evidence_note: Normative distinction: SC 1.2.3 is Level A and permits an audio description or a time-based media alternative; SC 1.2.5 is Level AA and requires audio description; SC 1.2.8 is Level AAA.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.2.5: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
sources.version_commit: WAI Understanding document, informative explanation; page states updated 2026-03-09.
sources.locator: SC 1.2.5; Intent note on when existing audio conveys all visual information; explanation of the Level A choice and additional Level AA requirement; advisory technique H96.
observed_operations: Read the full returned page, including the conformance-level explanation, exception note, and technique status.
sources.evidence_note: WAI explains that where all important video information is already conveyed in audio, no additional description is necessary; otherwise the Level A media-alternative choice does not replace the Level AA audio-description requirement. WAI lists use of the HTML track element as an advisory technique.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.2.2: Captions (Prerecorded)
sources.version_commit: WAI Understanding document, informative explanation; page states updated 2026-08-10.
sources.locator: Definition and intent for captions; dialogue and meaningful non-speech sound; language/style guidance.
observed_operations: Read the full returned page, including the captions definition and intent.
sources.evidence_note: The page distinguishes captions from dialogue-only subtitles and describes speech plus needed non-speech audio such as speaker identity and meaningful effects.

sources.title: HTML Standard — The track element
sources.version_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard as served 2026-10-09; mutable standard, no fixed revision identifier exposed by this page.
sources.locator: Track kinds, label, srclang, and default attributes; description kind.
observed_operations: Located and read track kind and attribute requirements, including the default-track constraints.
sources.evidence_note: The standard defines semantic track kinds and track metadata. Definition of a descriptions kind establishes a markup model; it does not by itself establish actual support in any selected user agent/player/assistive-technology combination.

sources.title: WebVTT: The Web Video Text Tracks Format
sources.version_commit: W3C WebVTT Candidate Recommendation Draft as served 2026-10-09.
sources.locator: Cue timing syntax and offsets; nondecreasing cue start offsets; end-after-start; ordered cues and permitted overlap.
observed_operations: Located and read cue timing and timestamp sections.
sources.evidence_note: Cue timestamps are media-relative offsets with millisecond components; cue starts are nondecreasing, each end exceeds its own start, and distinct cues may overlap.

sources.title: Able Player releases
sources.version_commit: Release listing observed 2026-10-09: latest stable shown as v5.0.0 (8d235f9, 2026-06-21); newer pre-release v5.1.0-beta2 (c4f10ab, 2026-10-06).
sources.locator: Release list; v5.1.0-beta2 pre-release and commit; v5.0.0 marked Latest stable release.
observed_operations: Opened the official GitHub release listing.
Read release order, stable/pre-release labels, commit identifiers, and available notes.
sources.evidence_note: The v5.0.0 stable baseline is supported. A newer beta exists; the listing alone does not establish that PR #778's change is included in that beta.

sources.title: Able Player issue #775 — develop YouTube regression report
sources.version_commit: Issue #775, opened 2026-08-12; issue and comments as observed 2026-10-09.
sources.locator: Issue description and tested-version caveat, including reporter's develop build, 17 of 60 demos, and checked-in build-directory behavior.
observed_operations: Read the reporter's description, version caveat, cited regression causes, and reproduction details.
sources.evidence_note: These are issue-reporter results, not an independent reproduction by this critic. The report distinguishes a freshly built develop tree from released v5.0.0 and says the checked-in build output was stale.

sources.title: Able Player PR #778 — Apply fixes for issues with YouTube
sources.version_commit: PR #778 merged 2026-09-13; merge commit cd617fc into develop.
observed_operations: Opened the exact public pull request.
Read merge target, commit identifier, date, and reported checks.
sources.evidence_note: The page reports seven checks passed and a merge into develop; this is not evidence that a stable release contains the fix.

sources.title: Subtitle Edit v5.2.0 release

Read the tagged version and release record.
